title: Anakin Skywalker
subtitle: Tempted by the Dark Side
text: Action [Exhaust, use the Force (lose your Force token)]: Play a Villainy non-unit card from your hand, ignoring its aspect penalties.
deployBox: Action [use the Force]: Play a Villainy non-unit card from your hand, ignoring its aspect penalties.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Abilities that let you play a card require you to pay that card’s cost unless specified otherwise.
Anakin's ability can be used to play Villainy Pilot cards as upgrades.
